name: Nginx Operations
description: Read the nginx config, test it before a reload, check the upstream, and verify the endpoint after a repair.

permissionsRequired.reason: Test and reload nginx on a configured server alias.
Read a local nginx config before editing it.
Run nginx -t on a local nginx.
Request the site after the reload.

validation.rule: nginx -t was run before a reload when nginx is available, and a follow-up status or endpoint check was reported after the repair.
